args: const {chromium}=require('@playwright/test');(async()=>{const b=await chromium.launch({headless:true});const p=await b.newPage();const errors=[];p.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push('PAGE '+e.message));p.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')errors.push('CONSOLE '+m.text())});const r=await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8765/experiments/typed-reconciler-cube/',{waitUntil:'networkidle'});await p.waitForTimeout(1000);console.log(JSON.stringify({status:r&&r.status(),title:await p.title(),validation:await p.locator('#validation').textContent(),boxes:await p.locator('.lattice-box').count(),errors},null,2));await b.close()})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.stack);process.exit(1)})
